Name: AllMighty
Author: deykfa
Description:
Mod that allow you to choose wanted professions besides that you already get. You can choose all professions in game at once, or precisely add only needed. Mod does not interact with save file, that mean you can delete or add it in any time.
Mod does not interact with professions that already in safe file. [1]
I know about mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url], but my mod working another way. [2]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
For the mod to work correctly, it needs the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed in the game. To configure options i recommend to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] in game menu.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install AllMighty archive.
Unzip the mod folder into [color=#93c47d][font=Verdana]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/color]
Run the game using SMAPI.
Before opening save file, open options, activate it by choosing first option and other that add professions. [3]
Open save file.

[size=4]If you like this mod please endorse it. If you find any bugs, please report them.[/size]

[spoiler][1] If you just want to change profession you can donating 10 000g to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/The_Sewers]Statue Of Uncertainty[/url] in sewer. 
[2] My mod is completely different from All Professions, i don't like the way this mod working so i made it by my way. Basically, the only difference in gameplay that my mod don't touch save files. 
[3] To change profession you need to save game (take a sleep), exit the game, open it again, open options of mod, change your choice, open save file. That's it.[/spoiler]
